title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Calanasan Central School to Pedro Bunot Central School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Calanasan Central School to Pedro Bunot Central School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1996/ra_8230_1996.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Calanasan Central School in the Municipality of Calanasan, Province of Apayao, shall be renamed Pedro Bunot Central School in honor of the late Mayor Bunot who served as mayor of Calanasan for an uninterrupted period of thirty (30) years
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
